extra_vocab.en: not made correctly and not working as it should
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，defective brakes 指推車煞車有瑕疵、無法正常運作，是客戶抱怨與零售商威脅取消訂單的原因；這是品管與客訴情境的常用字。

example.en: Customers can return any defective product within thirty days.
example.zh: 顧客可在三十天內退回任何瑕疵品。

example.en: The technician replaced the defective part free of charge.
example.zh: 技術人員免費更換了有瑕疵的零件。

example.en: All defective items must be reported before the end of the week.
example.zh: 所有有瑕疵的商品都必須在本週結束前回報。

examples.en: The retailer received several complaints about defective zippers.
examples.zh: 零售商收到好幾件有關拉鍊瑕疵的客訴。

examples.en: The inspector found that two percent of the units were defective.
examples.zh: 檢驗員發現百分之二的產品有瑕疵。

confusable.diff: effective 是「有效的」，字形與字尾相近，意思卻相反於 defective（有缺陷的）。

example.en: The new training method proved effective for all the new staff.
example.zh: 新的訓練方法對所有新進員工都很有效。

confusable.diff: defensive 是「防衛的、防禦性的」，開頭拼法相似，與瑕疵無關。

example.en: He became defensive when the manager questioned his report.
example.zh: 經理質疑他的報告時，他變得有些防衛。

similar.diff: faulty 較口語，常用於機器、電路、設備；defective 較正式，常用於產品與批次。

example.en: A faulty switch caused the machine to stop working.
example.zh: 一個有問題的開關讓機器停止運作。

similar.diff: broken 是「壞掉了」，可能是使用後才壞；defective 強調原本製造時就有問題。

example.en: The package arrived with a broken handle and a torn label.
example.zh: 包裹送達時把手斷了，標籤也撕破了。

example.en: Every batch goes through a careful inspection before shipping.
example.zh: 每一批貨在出貨前都要經過仔細檢驗。

example.en: We will send a replacement as soon as possible.
example.zh: 我們會盡快寄出更換品。

example.en: The warranty covers any defects for the first two years.
example.zh: 保固涵蓋前兩年內的任何瑕疵。

derived.link: defect 是詞幹；defect + -ive 變成形容詞 defective，像 act → active

extra_vocab.en: the way or the place where something is put
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，the placement of the brake cable 指煞車線「裝置的位置」，整批都稍微偏掉，所以問題出在製造設定，不是個別零件，逐一退款解決不了。

example.en: Correct placement of the sensor is important for accurate results.
example.zh: 感應器正確的擺放位置對準確的結果很重要。

collocations.zh: 產品置入、商品陳列位置

example.en: Product placement near the entrance can increase sales.
example.zh: 把商品陳列在入口附近能提高銷量。

example.en: The agency offers job placement services for recent graduates.
example.zh: 這家機構為應屆畢業生提供就業安置服務。

examples.en: A small error in placement can affect the whole assembly line.
examples.zh: 擺放位置的一個小錯誤，可能影響整條組裝線。

examples.en: The placement of the ad on the homepage cost extra.
examples.zh: 把廣告放在首頁的版位要額外收費。

confusable.diff: replacement 是「更換、替代品」，只多了 re-；placement 是「擺放的位置」。

example.en: The replacement arrived two days after we reported the problem.
example.zh: 我們回報問題兩天後，更換品就送到了。

similar.diff: positioning 強調「定位、擺放的動作與方式」，也用於市場定位；placement 強調最後放的位置。

example.en: The positioning of the logo on the box was changed.
example.zh: 標誌在箱子上的位置被改了。

similar.diff: location 是「地點、所在位置」，常指較大的地方；placement 指東西被放在哪裡的細節。

example.en: The new store location is close to the train station.
example.zh: 新店的地點靠近火車站。

example.en: Please check the position of the switch before starting.
example.zh: 開始前請檢查開關的位置。

example.en: The seating arrangement was changed for the client meeting.
example.zh: 為了客戶會議，座位安排被更動了。

example.en: Installation of the new brakes takes about ten minutes.
example.zh: 安裝新煞車大約要十分鐘。

derived.link: place 是詞幹；place + -ment 變成名詞，像 pay → payment、agree → agreement
re-（再一次）+ place，放另一個在原位，像 return、rebuild

senses.en: the way or place where something is put

example.en: The placement of the buttons makes the device easy to use.
example.zh: 按鈕的位置配置讓這個裝置很容易操作。

senses.en: the act of finding a job or a place for someone
senses.distinguish: 看到 job、student、agency 等字，多半是人員安置。

example.en: The school helps students with placement in local companies.
example.zh: 學校協助學生安置到本地公司工作。

senses.en: the act of putting an ad or product where people will see it
senses.distinguish: 看到 ad、product、shelf、website 等字，是廣告或商品的版位。

example.en: Ad placement on the front page is more expensive.
example.zh: 刊登在首頁的廣告費用比較貴。

extra_vocab.en: money that is paid back to a customer
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，issuing refunds one by one 是「逐一退款」的意思；因為問題出在整批，個別退款無法根本解決，所以才決定整批返工。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 名詞重音在前 /ˈriːfʌnd/，動詞重音在後 /rɪˈfʌnd/；要說「給某人退款」用 refund + 人 + 金額，或 give someone a refund。

example.en: The store agreed to issue a refund for the damaged item.
example.zh: 商店同意為受損的商品辦理退款。

example.en: Customers may request a refund within fourteen days of purchase.
example.zh: 顧客可在購買後十四天內申請退款。

example.en: We will offer a full refund if the product arrives late.
example.zh: 如果商品延遲送達，我們會提供全額退款。

example.en: Please read our refund policy before placing an order.
example.zh: 下單前，請先閱讀我們的退款政策。

examples.en: You will receive your refund within five business days.
examples.zh: 您會在五個工作天內收到退款。

examples.en: We apologize for the delay and will send a refund today.
examples.zh: 我們為延遲致歉，並將於今天退款。

confusable.diff: fund 是「資金、基金」；refund 是把已付的錢退回去，多了 re-（回）。

example.en: The fund will be used to build a new training center.
example.zh: 這筆資金將用來興建新的訓練中心。

similar.diff: reimburse 是「補償、報銷」已花的費用（如公司付差旅費）；refund 是把顧客付的錢退還。

example.en: The company will reimburse you for all travel expenses.
example.zh: 公司會報銷您所有的差旅費用。

similar.diff: money back 是口語，常見於廣告用語（money-back guarantee）；refund 較正式。

example.en: The product comes with a money back guarantee for thirty days.
example.zh: 這項產品附有三十天退款保證。

example.en: Please bring your receipt when you ask for a refund.
example.zh: 要求退款時，請攜帶收據。

example.en: You can ask for an exchange instead of a refund.
example.zh: 您可以要求換貨，而不是退款。

example.en: The store gave me a credit to use on my next order.
example.zh: 商店給了我一筆抵用額度，可用在下一筆訂單。

derived.link: non-（不）+ refundable，常見於機票、訂金

example.en: She asked for a refund because the item was damaged.
example.zh: 她因為商品受損而要求退款。

example.en: We will refund your payment if the order is canceled.
example.zh: 如果訂單取消，我們會退還您的款項。

extra_vocab.en: attention that a person, company, or product gets in the news or online
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，negative publicity 指負面的媒體或網路評論；Mia 擔心評價在網路上擴散會大幅損害銷量，所以主張儘快整批返工。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: publicity 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a publicity；要形容好壞用 good／bad／negative publicity。

example.en: Negative publicity can damage a brand within a few days.
example.zh: 負面報導可能在幾天內傷害一個品牌。

example.en: The charity event brought us good publicity in the local news.
example.zh: 這場慈善活動為我們在地方新聞中帶來正面宣傳。

example.en: The new logo helped generate publicity before the launch.
example.zh: 新標誌在上市前幫忙引起了關注。

example.en: Winning the award gave the company free publicity worldwide.
example.zh: 獲獎為公司帶來全球性的免費宣傳。

examples.en: We want to avoid any publicity until the problem is solved.
examples.zh: 在問題解決之前，我們想避免任何曝光。

examples.en: The publicity around the product launch attracted many new customers.
examples.zh: 產品上市的宣傳吸引了許多新顧客。

confusable.diff: publish 是動詞「出版、發表」；publicity 是名詞「公眾關注、宣傳」。
confusable.usage: publish 是動詞（publish a report）；publicity 是不可數名詞，不能當動詞用。

example.en: The magazine will publish our interview in next month's issue.
example.zh: 雜誌將在下個月的那一期刊登我們的訪談。

similar.diff: promotion 是公司主動做的促銷或推廣；publicity 多指受媒體或大眾關注，不一定自己花錢。

example.en: The store runs a special promotion every weekend.
example.zh: 這家店每個週末都有特別促銷。

similar.diff: media coverage 專指新聞媒體的報導；publicity 還包含網路口碑與社群討論。

example.en: The opening received wide media coverage across the country.
example.zh: 開幕獲得全國媒體廣泛報導。

example.en: A single mistake can harm a company's reputation.
example.zh: 一個錯誤就可能損害公司的名聲。

example.en: The press reported on the product recall this morning.
example.zh: 新聞媒體今天早上報導了這次產品回收。

example.en: The company worked hard to improve its public image.
example.zh: 公司努力改善它的公眾形象。

derived.link: public 是詞幹；public + -ity 變成名詞，像 active → activity
public + -ly，形容詞加 -ly 變副詞，像 quickly
publish 的字尾改成 -ication，變成名詞，像 apply → application

extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，substantially hurt our sales 表示負面報導會「大幅」損害銷量，語氣強調影響程度大，是商務對話中常見的強調副詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: substantially 常放在動詞前或比較級前（substantially higher）；形容詞是 substantial，用來修飾名詞（a substantial increase）。

example.en: Our online orders increased substantially during the holiday season.
example.zh: 假期期間，我們的線上訂單大幅增加。

example.en: The two proposals differ substantially in cost and schedule.
example.zh: 這兩份提案在成本與時程上差異很大。

example.en: The new process will reduce waiting time substantially.
example.zh: 新流程將大幅減少等待時間。

example.en: Prices in this area are substantially higher than in the suburbs.
example.zh: 這個地區的價格比郊區高出許多。

examples.en: The new model is substantially lighter than the old one.
examples.zh: 新機型比舊機型輕許多。

examples.en: Delays could substantially affect our delivery date for the order.
examples.zh: 延誤可能大幅影響我們這筆訂單的交貨日。

confusable.diff: substitute 是「替代品；取代」，開頭拼法 sub- 相近，但意思無關。

example.en: You can use a similar part as a substitute for this one.
example.zh: 你可以用類似的零件來代替這一個。

similar.diff: significantly 強調「明顯到值得注意」，常用於數據與分析；substantially 強調「量或程度很大」。

example.en: Sales improved significantly after the new campaign started.
example.zh: 新活動開始後，銷售有明顯的改善。

similar.diff: considerably 語氣稍柔和，意思是「相當地」；substantially 更強調數量上的大。

example.en: Shipping costs are considerably lower than we expected.
example.zh: 運費比我們預期的低了不少。

example.en: Profits dropped dramatically after the factory closed.
example.zh: 工廠關閉後，利潤急遽下降。

example.en: The price has risen slightly since last month.
example.zh: 價格自上個月以來略為上漲。

example.en: Customer satisfaction has noticeably improved this quarter.
example.zh: 本季客戶滿意度有明顯改善。

derived.link: substance 是詞幹；去掉 -ce 加 -tial，變成形容詞「實質的」substantial
substance 變形 + -ial，變成形容詞，像 office → official
